name: Detrital Processing (CPOM retention / shredders)
functionStatement: Organic matter is captured and broken down, fueling food webs, balancing production/ respiration, moderating pH/ redox, and supplying nutrients.
descriptionMarkdown: "Leaf litter/coarse organic matter are visibly retained, supporting detrital processes per local references. Quick checks show these invertebrates, indicating healthy detrital processing (if typical)."
howToMeasureMarkdown: "Count leaf packs and small debris dams, or infer retention from wood presence and low-velocity habitat during a field visit. Conduct a rapid kick sample and note presence of shredder taxa where a CPOM pathway is expected."

inputs.label: Detrital Processing (CPOM retention / shredders)
inputs.helpMarkdown: High resolution aerial imagery; Field photos; Brief field recon; Historical evidence

levels.label: Good
levels.criteriaMarkdown: Abundant CPOM retention with stable leaf packs typical for the system.

levels.label: Fair
levels.criteriaMarkdown: Some retention but partially flushed out. / Sparse organic matter and limited retention.

levels.label: Poor
levels.criteriaMarkdown: Essentially no retained organic matter, or severe overload causing anoxia risk.

references: planform complexity from imagery as supporting context.
State biomonitoring portals and/or EPA Water Quality Portal biological results (where available).
